text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Dad! Hurry up! Her race is about
to start!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Father
text_block_list.text:
Slow down, Cassie! Your hat's gonna fly
off if you
run like that!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Damn, place is packed. Looks like Ines is
running
in another super big-deal race,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text:
Guess so. But knowing her, she's gonna
be just
fine.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, can I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What do you think's the difference
between me
and Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think on her question for a moment. A
Mejiro on
the one hand, and on the
other... my trainee.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sure. That's true.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I think you're right. Ryan's trying
to carry
the whole Mejiro family, just like
McQueen is.
choice_data_list: レースにかける想いも違う

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I'm just running because I want to
run.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I don't have some kind of big goal like
that. I just
run based on how I feel.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...So how come you've kept supporting
me all this
time?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I work hard?
choice_data_list: 君が一生懸命だったから
貴方が一生懸命だったから

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She works hard at school, at home, at
work, and
on the track too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I think you said something like that
before,
actually.
choice_data_list: 全力で頑張る君の走りが好きなんだ
全力で頑張る貴方の走りが好きなんだ

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You said you like seeing me enjoy
running. So,
ever since then, you've—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You said you like seeing me enjoy
running. So,
ever since then, you've—
choice_data_list: きっとみんなも一緒だよ

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Everyone?
choice_data_list: きっとみんなも一緒だよ

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: みんなで君と夢を見たいんだ
みんなで貴方と夢を見たいんだ

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You want to dream... with me. Huh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: A lot! That was a great answer!
choice_data_list: 何か助けになったかな？

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading to the paddock! I'll give you
a taste
of what's to come—the joy of
victory, shared with
me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I understand now, Ryan. The reason you
told me
I don't have to bear the
burden.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fans
text_block_list.text:
McQueeen! Use this race to showcase
the pride of
the Mejiro family! We
simply can't wait to witness
your victory!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(The hopes people are pinning on
McQueen and
Ryan, the stuff their fans
are shouting... It's all a
bit different from
what I get from my fans.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(They're expected to be a certain way,
and
people want them to do certain
things. But...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fans
text_block_list.text:
You can do it, Big Sis!
Gooooo, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My fans aren't so much pinning their
expectations
on me... it's more like
they're just encouraging me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Which means I don't have to burden
myself. My
fans and I have been
dreaming together from the
start.
